in_sanskrit.name: अवधूत
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who is free from worldly desires and attachments.
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अव - not, धूत - desire, attachment. A person who has renounced all worldly desires and attachments.

in_hindi.name: अवधूत
in_hindi.long_meaning: वि - without, रागी - desire, attachment. A person who has renounced all worldly desires and attachments.

in_tamil.name: அவதூத
in_tamil.long_meaning: அல்லவாய் - not, அன்புக்கள் - desires, attachments, அவசாரம் - state. A person who is in a state where they have renounced all desires and attachments.

in_marathi.name: Avadhoot
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God-realized or Free from worldly desires
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avadhoot हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is free from worldly desires, has realized God, and has transcended the cycle of birth and death.

in_bengali.name: Avadhoot
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God-realized or Free from worldly desires
in_bengali.long_meaning: Avadhoot একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is free from worldly desires, has realized God, and has transcended the cycle of birth and death.
